supports.name: Spectre Heavy Gunship
supports.description: Future C-130-style side-firing gunship enters a safe orbit and suppresses surface lanes with heavy cannon fire.

supports.name: Atlas Tanker
supports.description: Large tanker/rearm aircraft deploys a hose corridor. Maintaining position restores fuel-equivalent energy, support readiness, bombs and limited airframe stores.

supports.name: Rapier Fighter Flight
supports.description: Friendly fighter element crosses the combat zone, engaging air targets and drawing hostile fire.

supports.name: Hammer Bomber Flight
supports.description: Friendly strike bombers perform an authored surface attack run across marked ground or naval targets.

supports.name: Cruise Missile Battery
supports.description: Stand-off missile battery attacks a marked hardened or high-value target with a visible inbound trajectory.

supports.name: Longshot Rail Battery
supports.description: Late-game electromagnetic battery charges and fires a high-velocity penetrator through a marked lane or boss weak point.

supports.name: Orbital Strike Platform
supports.description: Strategic late-game platform delivers a tightly bounded orbital kinetic strike after a long telegraph.
